# clone with different key

Let `clone` ([[DOT-242]]) use a specific SSH key, for repositories that a different identity has access to:

```
GIT_SSH_COMMAND='ssh -i ~/.ssh/<key>' git clone git@bitbucket.org:<some>/<private>.git
```
